records.text: The Olmsted County integration reportedly reduced employee file-management time by 90%, eliminated duplicate data entry, and resolved 12 of 24 paper- and data-processing substeps through auto-population across connected systems. The source reported 53% of trade permits and 66% of new well permits were submitted online, with those shares growing monthly; approximately 46% of people who made online payments in the prior four months had started their application process.
